title: runBenchmark
responsibility: Schedules reproducible trials, persists each outcome and attributes benchmark analytics to the source project.

inputs.name: runBenchmark.input
inputs.description: Definition path, explicit runners, private repository and cancellation context.

inputs.name: benchmarkSchedule.run
inputs.description: Pinned benchmark definition, candidate configurations and recorded trial outcomes.

outputs.name: runBenchmark
outputs.description: Persisted run with each completed, failed or interrupted trial outcome.

outputs.name: benchmarkSchedule
outputs.description: Seeded candidate ordering for each declared repetition.
